test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Directions: Each item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words/group of words. Select the option that is nearest in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response on the answer sheet accordingly.

This is __credible__ information provided by the informer.
solution: The correct answer is "dependable."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • The word "credible" means that you can believe. (विश्‍वसनीय; विश्‍वास करने योग्‍य) • Example: *It’s hardly **credible**__ that such a thing could happen without him knowing it.* • The synonym of "credible" is "dependable." • The word "dependable" means that someone can be trusted. (भरोसेमंद, विश्‍वसनीय, भरोसे लायक़) __ • Example: *The bus service is very **dependable**__.* • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Commendable: **that people think is good. (सराहनीय, प्रशंसनीय, प्रशंसा योग्‍य) • **Detachable: **that can be separated from something it is connected to. (जो जिससे जुड़ा है, उससे अलग किया जा सके; वियोज्‍य) • **Digestible: **(used about food) easy for your body to deal with (digest). ((भोजन) सुपाच्‍य) 141:T828, The correct answer is "BADC."
